505 * Poll the backend for progress info every 100ms until cancelled by caller.
506 * Calls extractProgress() to gather progress info and write it into
507 * [ProgressContext]. Calls updateUi() to update the UI with the extracted
508 * progress.
509 */
510private suspend fun monitorProgress(
511 backend: Backend,
512 extractProgress: ProgressContext.() -> Unit,
513 updateUi: ProgressContext.() -> Unit,
514) {
515 val state = ProgressContext(Progress.getDefaultInstance())
516 while (true) {
517 state.progress =
518 withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
519 backend.latestProgress()
520 }
521 state.extractProgress()
522 // on main thread, so op can update UI
523 withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
524 state.updateUi()
525 }
526 delay(100)
527 }
528}

1774
1775 Timber.i("Closing note editor")
1776

1778 val animation =
1779 BundleCompat.getParcelable(
1780 requireArguments(),
1781 AnkiActivity.FINISH_ANIMATION_EXTRA,
1782 ActivityTransitionAnimation.Direction::class.java,
1783 )
1784 if (animation != null) {
1785 requireAnkiActivity().finishWithAnimation(animation)
1786 } else {
1787 finish()
1788 }
1789 }

2784 ) {

2788 if (i < tmpls.length() - 1) {
2789 cardsList.append(", ")
2790 }
2791 }
2792 // Make cards list red if the number of cards is being reduced
2793 if (!addNote && tmpls.length() < editorNote!!.notetype.templates.length()) {
2794 cardsList = StringBuilder("<font color='red'>$cardsList</font>")

499 private fun Collection.fetchStudyOptionsData(): DeckStudyData {

502 var buriedNew = 0
503 var buriedLearning = 0
504 var buriedReview = 0
505 val tree = sched.deckDueTree(deckId)

508 buriedLearning = tree.learnCount - counts.lrn
509 buriedReview = tree.reviewCount - counts.rev
510 }

512 newCardsToday = counts.new,
513 lrnCardsToday = counts.lrn,
514 revCardsToday = counts.rev,
515 buriedNew = buriedNew,
516 buriedLearning = buriedLearning,
517 buriedReview = buriedReview,
518 totalNewCards = sched.totalNewForCurrentDeck(),
519 numberOfCardsInDeck = decks.cardCount(deckId, includeSubdecks = true),
520 )

271 return collectionWillBeMadeInaccessibleAfterUninstall(windowContext)

40 fun loadFieldEditLines(type: FieldChangeType): List<FieldEditLine> {
41 val fieldEditLines: List<FieldEditLine> =
42 if (type.type == Type.INIT && customViewIds != null) {
43 recreateFields(customViewIds!!)
44 } else {
45 createFields(type).also { fields ->
46 for (field in fields) {
47 field.id = View.generateViewId()
48 }
49 }
50 }
51
52 if (type.type == Type.CLEAR_KEEP_STICKY) {
53 // we use the UI values here as the model will post-processing steps (newline -> br).
54 val currentFieldStrings = editor.currentFieldStrings
55 for ((fldIdx, field) in editor.currentFields.withIndex()) {
56 if (field.sticky) {
57 fieldEditLines[fldIdx].setContent(currentFieldStrings[fldIdx], type.replaceNewlines)
58 }
59 }
60 }
61 if (type.type == Type.CHANGE_FIELD_COUNT) {
62 val currentFieldStrings = editor.currentFieldStrings
63 for (i in 0 until min(currentFieldStrings.size, fieldEditLines.size)) {
64 fieldEditLines[i].setContent(currentFieldStrings[i], type.replaceNewlines)
65 }
66 }
67 return fieldEditLines
68 }

74 private fun recreateFields(viewIds: List<Int>): List<FieldEditLine> =
75 viewIds.map { id -> FieldEditLine(editor.requireContext()).also { field -> field.id = id } }

81 val editLineView = FieldEditLine(editor.requireContext())
82 editLines.add(editLineView)
83 editLineView.name = fields[i][0]
84 editLineView.setContent(fields[i][1], type.replaceNewlines)
85 editLineView.setOrd(i)

25open class AnkiServer(
26 private val postHandler: PostRequestHandler,
27 port: Int = 0,
28) : NanoHTTPD(LOCALHOST, port) {
29 fun baseUrl(): String = "http://$LOCALHOST:$listeningPort/"
30
31 // it's faster to serve local files without GZip. see 'page render' in logs
32 // This also removes 'W/System: A resource failed to call end.'
33 override fun useGzipWhenAccepted(r: Response?) = false
34
35 override fun serve(session: IHTTPSession): Response =
36 when (session.method) {
37 Method.POST -> {
38 val uri = session.uri
39 Timber.d("POST: Requested %s", uri)
40 val inputBytes = getSessionBytes(session)
41
42 try {
43 val data = runBlocking { postHandler.handlePostRequest(PostRequestUri(uri), inputBytes) }
44 buildResponse(data)
45 } catch (exception: Exception) {
46 Timber.w(exception, "buildResponse failure")
47 buildResponse(exception.localizedMessage?.encodeToByteArray(), status = Response.Status.INTERNAL_ERROR)
48 }
49 }
50 Method.GET -> {
51 Timber.d("Rejecting GET request to server %s", session.uri)
52 newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND, null, null)
53 }
54 else -> {
55 Timber.d("Ignored request of unhandled method %s, uri %s", session.method, session.uri)
56 newFixedLengthResponse(null)
57 }
58 }
59
60 private fun buildResponse(
61 data: ByteArray?,
62 mimeType: String = "application/binary",
63 status: Response.IStatus = Response.Status.OK,
64 ): Response =
65 if (data == null) {
66 newFixedLengthResponse(null)
67 } else {
68 newChunkedResponse(status, mimeType, ByteArrayInputStream(data))
69 }
70

72 const val LOCALHOST = "127.0.0.1"
73
74 /** Common prefix used on Anki requests */
75 const val ANKI_PREFIX = "/_anki/"
76 const val ANKIDROID_JS_PREFIX = "/jsapi/"
77
78 fun getSessionBytes(session: IHTTPSession): ByteArray {
79 val contentLength = session.headers["content-length"]!!.toInt()
80 val bytes = ByteArray(contentLength)
81 session.inputStream.read(bytes, 0, contentLength)
82 return bytes
83 }
84 }

170 /** The requested method was not a valid UI POST request */
171 data object UnknownMethod : UiPostRequestResponse()
172
173 /**
174 * A valid method could not be executed
175 *
176 * For example: if the calling fragment was not attached to an activity
⋮
178 data object Ignored : UiPostRequestResponse()
179
180 /**
181 * The request was handled by the backend (success/failure)
182 */
183 data class Handled(
184 val data: ByteArray,
185 ) : UiPostRequestResponse() {
186 override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
187 if (this === other) return true
188 if (javaClass != other?.javaClass) return false
189
190 other as Handled
⋮
194
195 override fun hashCode(): Int = data.contentHashCode()
196 }
197}

199suspend fun FragmentActivity?.handleUiPostRequest(
200 methodName: String,
201 bytes: ByteArray,
202): UiPostRequestResponse {
203 // an unknown method may be valid for another request handler
204 val uiMethod = uiMethods[methodName] ?: return UiPostRequestResponse.UnknownMethod
205
206 // a resolved but ignored method should not be retried
207 if (this == null) {
208 Timber.w("ignored UI request '%s' - activity == null", methodName)
209 return UiPostRequestResponse.Ignored
210 }
211
212 val data = uiMethod.invoke(this, bytes).await()
213 when (methodName) {
214 "addImageOcclusionNote" -> {
215 undoableOp { OpChanges.parseFrom(data) }
216 launchCatchingTask {
217 // Allow time for toast message to appear before closing editor
218 delay(1000)
219 setResult(Activity.RESULT_OK)
220 finish()
221 }
222 }
223
224 "updateImageOcclusionNote" -> {
225 undoableOp { OpChanges.parseFrom(data) }
226 launchCatchingTask {
227 // Allow time for toast message to appear before closing editor
228 delay(1000)
229 setResult(NoteEditorFragment.RESULT_UPDATED_IO_NOTE)
230 finish()
231 }
232 }
233 }
234 return UiPostRequestResponse.Handled(data)
235}

57/**
58 * Enforces single execution of a coroutine task
59 * if a task is running, ignore any other requests till it finishes
60 * @param scope The coroutine scope where the task is launched
61 */
62class RunOnlyOnce(
63 private val scope: CoroutineScope,
64) {
65 private var job: Job? = null
66
67 fun launch(block: suspend CoroutineScope.() -> Unit) {
68 if (job?.isActive == true) {
69 Timber.d("skipped multiple executions of job")
70 return
71 }
72 job = scope.launch(block = block)
73 }
74}

83 }
84 val revuelto = StringBuilder()
85 for (element in huevo) {
86 var c = element
87 when (c) {
88 in 'a'..'m' -> {
89 c += 13.toChar().code
90 }
91 in 'A'..'M' -> {
92 c += 13.toChar().code
93 }
94 in 'n'..'z' -> {
95 c -= 13.toChar().code
96 }
97 in 'N'..'Z' -> c -= 13.toChar().code
98 }
99 revuelto.append(c)
100 }
101 return revuelto.toString()
102 }
